errors.evidence: The first category listed on the x-axis is "Финансови / ликвидност". The description incorrectly prepends "Прекъсване на", which is part of the label for the third category, "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара".
The bar for the first category, "Финансови / ликвидност", reaches a value of approximately 23% on the y-axis, which is significantly more than "just over 20%".
The category label is "Хуманитарно" (Humanitarian), not "Хуманно място" (Humane place).

The description states that the categories "Хуманитарно", "Тероризъм", and "Други" have values under 5%. In the chart, "Хуманитарно" and "Тероризъм" are both approximately 7%, and "Други" is exactly 5%, not under 5%.
